name: SE Ranking
one_liner: REST API providing SEO and AI search data, plus MCP for AI assistants.

evidence.snippet: SEO API by SE Ranking: SEO & GEO Data at Scale
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent to access your SE Ranking data in a simple and secure way.
First, you’ll need to generate a unique API key from your account dashboard.
SE Ranking doesn’t currently offer first-party SDKs and integration is done via the REST API reference and a Postman collection for endpoint testing.
To authenticate your requests, include the API key in the `Authorization` header of your HTTP requests, using the `Token` scheme.
The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access.
